name: Banh goi Nam Dinh
summary: A Hoa-influenced fried cake of rice paper brushed with wheat flour, filled with pork, wood-ear, quail egg, and glass noodles, and not the Hanoi bánh gối. Straight from the oil with sour-sweet fish sauce, it is fragrant and crisp without being greasy.
origin: Nam Định. Thế giới tiếp thị, 12 September 2022. Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 places it on Nguyễn Văn Trỗi and Hoàng Văn Thụ.
texture: Fried as soon as it is wrapped, turned so both sides color. Eaten at once, it is fragrant and crisp, and Thế giới tiếp thị says it is not greasy.
howToEat: Straight from the pan, with sour-sweet fish sauce, chili, garlic, herbs, and dưa góp.
where: Nguyễn Văn Trỗi and Hoàng Văn Thụ.
seoTitle: Banh goi Nam Dinh — fried, not the Hanoi cake
seoDescription: A crisp fried cake of rice paper and wheat flour, filled with pork, wood-ear, quail egg, and glass noodles, on Nguyễn Văn Trỗi and Hoàng Văn Thụ.
